{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_, threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Concurrent.STM (TVar, newTVarIO, readTVarIO, writeTVar, atomically)
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.AES as AES
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.Types as CT
import qualified Crypto.Error as CE
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef (IORef, newIORef, readIORef, writeIORef, atomicModifyIORef')
import Data.Word (Word64)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import System.Posix.Signals (installHandler, sigTERM, sigINT, Handler(..))

data ServiceState = ServiceState
  { ssKey        :: BS.ByteString
  , ssNonce     :: IORef Word64
  , ssShutdown  :: TVar Bool
  , ssEpoch     :: MVar Word64
  }

initService :: IO ServiceState
initService = do
  let masterKey = BS.pack [0x2b,0x7e,0x15,0x16,0x28,0xae,0xd2,0xa6,
                           0xab,0xf7,0x15,0x88,0x09,0xcf,0x4f,0x3c]
  nonceRef <- newIORef 0
  shutdownVar <- newTVarIO False
  epochVar <- newMVar 0
  return $ ServiceState masterKey nonceRef shutdownVar epochVar

deriveSessionKey :: BS.ByteString -> Word64 -> BS.ByteString
deriveSessionKey master epoch =
  let epochBytes = encodeWord64 epoch
      padded = BS.append epochBytes (BS.replicate 8 0)
      cipher = case CE.eitherCryptoError (AES.cipherInit master :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES128) of
                 Right c -> c
                 Left e  -> error (show e)
  in CT.ecbEncrypt cipher padded

encodeWord64 :: Word64 -> BS.ByteString
encodeWord64 w = BS.pack $ map (\i -> fromIntegral (w `div` (256^i) `mod` 256)) [0..7]

encryptMessage :: BS.ByteString -> Word64 -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encryptMessage sessionKey nonce plaintext =
  let iv = BS.append (encodeWord64 nonce) (BS.replicate 8 0)
      cipher = case CE.eitherCryptoError (AES.cipherInit sessionKey :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES128) of
                 Right c -> c
                 Left e  -> error (show e)
      paddedPt = padPKCS7 plaintext
  in CT.cbcEncrypt cipher (CT.makeIV iv `orDie` "IV creation failed") paddedPt

orDie :: Maybe a -> String -> a
orDie (Just x) _ = x
orDie Nothing msg = error msg

padPKCS7 :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
padPKCS7 bs =
  let padLen = 16 - (BS.length bs `mod` 16)
  in BS.append bs (BS.replicate padLen (fromIntegral padLen))

handleRequest :: ServiceState -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
handleRequest state plaintext = do
  shutting <- readTVarIO (ssShutdown state)
  when shutting $ error "Service shutting down"
  epoch <- readMVar (ssEpoch state)
  let sessionKey = deriveSessionKey (ssKey state) epoch
  nonce <- atomicModifyIORef' (ssNonce state) (\n -> (n + 1, n))
  return $ encryptMessage sessionKey nonce plaintext

rotateEpoch :: ServiceState -> IO ()
rotateEpoch state = do
  modifyMVar_ (ssEpoch state) (\e -> return (e + 1))
  writeIORef (ssNonce state) 0

gracefulShutdown :: ServiceState -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown state = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (ssShutdown state) True
  putStrLn "Initiating graceful shutdown..."
  threadDelay 500000
  epoch <- readMVar (ssEpoch state)
  let finalKey = deriveSessionKey (ssKey state) epoch
  nonce <- readIORef (ssNonce state)
  let shutdownMsg = encryptMessage finalKey nonce (BC.pack "SHUTDOWN_ACK")
  BC.putStrLn $ BC.append "Final broadcast: " (BC.pack $ show $ BS.unpack shutdownMsg)
  hFlush stdout

main :: IO ()
main = do
  state <- initService
  _ <- installHandler sigTERM (Catch $ gracefulShutdown state) Nothing
  _ <- installHandler sigINT (Catch $ gracefulShutdown state) Nothing
  _ <- forkIO $ forever $ do
    threadDelay 3600000000
    rotateEpoch state
  putStrLn "Service started."
  forever $ do
    shutting <- readTVarIO (ssShutdown state)
    unless shutting $ do
      ct <- handleRequest state (BC.pack "heartbeat")
      threadDelay 1000000
